bounds: One model-free native profile, two selected payers and one preserved owner-data token. State represents completed configuration projections.
limitations: No concurrent boot, partial disk writes or process crash model. Default native local-model profile keeps its existing owner preferences and is checked separately by existing tests.

Weak fairness assumes a valid Cloud binding is eventually admitted and applied; it does not assume provider availability or image recognition. Actual handler HTTP is synthetic and local. Real phone vision remains a separate acceptance gate.

assumptions: Weak fairness of applying a valid Cloud binding.
